action_summary: A try is only informative if the machine can tell whether it FAILED BECAUSE IT CANNOT ACT HERE. Round 3's audit found facts where the registry could not even ask that question: BLIND -- no capability produces the fact, no sensor reads it -- so capabilities held by them were auto-refused with no evidence. This round gives world_probe_v1 honest instruments for nine of the ten remaining blind facts: the git binary for git.repository.available (the operate adapter shells out to it); a TCP probe scoped to pypi.org for the two pypi facts (the same instrument convention as network.http.available: it decides the ROUTE, never 'may I fetch'); the network route for structured.release_claim.available (the claim arrives over HTTP; content stays the adapter's job); and the raster-chart subsystem (PIL importable AND tesseract on PATH -- the imports the adapters actually make, the binary they actually call) for the five chart facts. source.candidate.provenance.verified STAYS BLIND on purpose: nothing produces it and a file-existence scan would fabricate 'verified'. MEASURED: fact_classes {PROVIDED 100, SENSED 24, BLIND 1}; 143 of 145 capabilities fully decidable (was 135); at the front door the three true-premise capabilities no longer reject with PRECONDITION_NOT_TRUE_OF_WORLD (git -> ACTION_FAILED past the premise gate, pypi -> ACTION_FAILED, web.release -> AMBIGUOUS) and the four chart capabilities reject with NAMED missing dependencies instead of an undecidable shrug. First confirmatory run missed 2 of 10 predictions (chart.question.* does not END with .question, so the suffix strip could not reach 'chart'); the fix was explicit reviewable subject rows, not a suffix hack. Also fixes a PRE-EXISTING stale-pin failure on main (the tree measured BLIND 10/SENSED 15 while the test pinned 11/14). Two further test failures are reproduced on the clean base with this round stashed and recorded as pre-existing environment-dependent fixtures, out of scope. Placement per the corrected ordering (A_PERFECT_ACTION_IS_NOT_AN_AVAILABLE_ACTION): prerequisite layer, NOT the gain item -- binding (54 capabilities, 37%) remains the dominant measured blocker and is the named next round.
